title: ID0415269-DC/Si-D/FR- [MP / P6 170000696] Cracks inside the HMI Screen
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Hello, as you can see in the photos, the screen has some cracks inside the screen. Indeed, there is no traces of impact. When I put my finger in the screen I don't feel any cracks. Plus, when you are in front of the screen you can't see the cracks, you have to stay on the side of the charger to see them. Can you send the ticket to the French team please? to plan an intervention. Thank you
Root cause:
Solution:
Warranty Status: Expired (6/8/2024)

Hello Boddeda,
The defect is known at some Blackpanles.
However, we have not received a conclusive statement from our supplier.
Due to the material pairing, the impact of the outer glass plate is passed directly onto the inner glass plate without damaging the outer one.
It means, we cannot exclude the damage by an external force.
